projects.name: ASCII-Paint
projects.description: A desktop ASCII art and animation editor.
projects.details: A desktop editor for creating ASCII art and frame-based animations. It is written in Rust and will move to the SimpleUI front end after the first SimpleUI release.
highlights: Character-based drawing and animation tools
Native desktop application written in Rust
Prebuilt executables are published on GitHub Releases

projects.name: SpaceGlider
projects.description: SpaceGlider is a small word-based file compressor written in Java
projects.details: A lossless, word-based file compressor written in Java. It splits text into words and whitespace, gives frequent tokens shorter byte codes, and writes the result to a .space file. A 1 GB enwik9 test corpus compressed to 567 MB.
highlights: Lossless word-based compression
Variable-length byte codes based on token frequency
Command-line compression and extraction

projects.name: SimpleUI
projects.description: A lightweight, self-contained declarative desktop UI engine, still in developpement.
projects.details: A lightweight, self-contained declarative UI engine for desktop applications, written in C++. The project is still in early development.
highlights: Declarative desktop UI
Self-contained C++ implementation

projects.name: ltk-manager
projects.description: Mod manager and Modding IDE for League of Legends.
projects.details: The League Toolkit mod manager and modding IDE for League of Legends. It installs custom skins, HUDs, maps, and audio; manages mod libraries and profiles; checks mod health after game patches; and includes a Workshop for browsing game files and packaging mods. This is an open-source project I contributed to.
highlights: Contributed to the LeagueToolkit ltk-manager project
Tauri desktop app with a Rust backend and TypeScript UI
Mod library, profiles, mod health checks, and a built-in Workshop

projects.name: Playin
projects.description: Native Android app that enables Youtube video download
projects.details: Playin is a Kotlin application for Android that downloads YouTube videos directly on the device.

projects.name: RustySteamless
projects.description: Steamless DRM remover rewritten to Rust
projects.details: A cross-platform rewrite of Steamless in Rust. It removes SteamStub DRM from executable files so they can be analyzed or modified, and ships as a Tauri desktop app plus a CLI for automated use. The unpacking logic is ported from the original Steamless project by atom0s.
highlights: Tauri desktop app and command-line interface
Windows, macOS, and Linux builds
SteamStub DRM removal for analysis and modification

projects.name: DofusMulti
projects.description: Reconstruction of a reverse engineered multi proxy bot
projects.details: DofusMulti is a Rust project that reconstructs a reverse-engineered multi-client proxy bot for Dofus.

projects.name: ltk-bot
projects.description: LTK Discord server management bot
projects.details: ltk-bot is a Python Discord bot used to manage the League Toolkit server.

projects.name: IpLock
projects.description: A server-side Minecraft mod that binds usernames to IP addresses to prevent account takeovers.
projects.details: IpLock prevents account takeovers on offline-mode Minecraft servers by permanently binding each username to the IP address it first joined from. A matching IP joins normally; a different IP is rejected and banned. Bindings and bans are stored in JSON files, and operators can list bindings, review bans, unban IPs, and reset a username's binding.
highlights: Permanently binds each username to its first IP address
Rejects and bans connections from mismatched IPs
Operator commands for bindings, bans, unbanning, and resets
Supports Fabric and Spigot servers

projects.name: TeleportGate
projects.description: A Minecraft plugin that adds configurable, code-based teleport gates.
projects.details: TeleportGate is a Spigot 1.21 plugin that adds craftable teleport gates to a Minecraft server. Each gate receives a unique four-digit code, and players can right-click a gate and enter another gate's code to travel there instantly. Gate codes float above each gate, and the crafting recipe is configurable in config.json.
highlights: Gate-to-gate travel using four-digit codes
Craftable gates with a configurable recipe
Floating code display above every gate
Spigot 1.21 support

projects.name: veryHotBar
projects.description: A lightweight Fabric mod for managing inventory rows and hotbar slots with the arrow keys.
projects.details: veryHotbar is a lightweight Fabric quality-of-life mod that makes inventory management faster without opening menus. Up and Down arrows swap the hotbar with inventory rows, while Left and Right arrows cycle through hotbar slots, giving players quicker access to tools, weapons, and blocks during combat or building.
highlights: Up/Down arrows swap the hotbar with inventory rows
Left/Right arrows cycle hotbar slots instantly
No inventory screens required
Lightweight, vanilla-style controls

projects.name: ConvertAll
projects.description: Desktop software that enables multi extension converting.
projects.details: ConvertAll is a Rust desktop utility for converting files between multiple extensions.

projects.name: OtpServer
projects.description: SelfHosted solution that syncs totp across multiple devices.
projects.details: A self-hosted sync server for Offline Authenticator. It keeps TOTP accounts synchronized across devices while storing all data on your own server. The service uses SQLite persistence, exposes an HTTP API, and runs through Docker Compose.
highlights: Self-hosted TOTP synchronization
SQLite storage with Docker Compose deployment
JWT-protected account sync API

projects.name: CampusEvent
projects.description: CampusEvents is a university event app for students and admins to browse, favorite, register for, and manage campus events, with AI-powered event search and recommendations.
projects.details: CampusEvents is a TypeScript university event app with separate student and admin flows. Students browse, favorite, and register for events, while admins create and manage listings; AI-assisted search and recommendations help surface relevant events.

projects.name: BoolEfficient
projects.description: Bit-Packed Boolean Storage System that is more memory efficient than bool. Instead of using 1 byte per bool, this solution uses 1 byte per 8 bool values.
projects.details: A bit-packed boolean storage system implemented in C. It packs eight boolean values into one byte instead of using a byte per bool, reducing memory usage for large collections of flags.

projects.name: RadminVPN-Linux
projects.description: RadminVPN reverse engineered to port the solution to Linux.
projects.details: A reverse-engineering project that documents and reimplements Radmin VPN behavior to provide a Linux-compatible client, written in Python.

projects.name: TheWolf
projects.description: JustLikeAnimals Discord server management bot.
projects.details: A Python Discord bot that handles moderation and community management tasks for the JustLikeAnimals server.

projects.name: SmartBudget
projects.description: Kotlin-based budgeting app for managing college-related finances and expenses.
projects.details: A Kotlin app that helps students plan monthly budgets, record expenses, and keep track of college-related spending.

projects.name: SmartIntell
projects.description: Smart eCommerce Intelligence is a multi agentic A2A pipeline that scraps and organize ecommerce websites.
projects.details: Smart eCommerce Intelligence is a Python multi-agent A2A pipeline that splits e-commerce scraping, extraction, and organization across cooperating agents.

projects.name: StoneRose
projects.description: A small scripts to go around boring and non efficient Rosetta Stone learning platform
projects.details: A collection of small scripts that work around the Rosetta Stone learning platform, targeting repetitive lessons and platform interactions to reduce manual effort.

projects.name: ProjectManager
projects.description: PHP-based project management application for planning, tracking, and organizing project workflows and tasks.
projects.details: A PHP application that centralizes project planning, task tracking, and workflow organization for teams.

projects.name: NotifTweak
projects.description: A Flutter & Kotlin android app that lets the user customize how he receives notifications.
projects.details: A mobile solution that enables users to control when, how, and which notifications they receive by offering granular filtering, intelligent delivery, and customizable audio controls. Users can silence alerts and schedule them to arrive in batched summaries, while automatically discarding low-priority updates; such as muting promotional messages from an app while retaining essential service updates. Additionally, the system features customizable notification sounds per app and a sound cooldown timer to prevent continuous audio alerts during rapid notification bursts.

projects.name: Offline Authenticator
projects.description: A Flutter app that provides the ability to store, and sync with a cloud server TOTPs.
projects.details: A Flutter app that provides the ability to store, and sync with a cloud server TOTPs, it comes paired with OtpServer.
